title: valeriana dageletiana f. integra
intro: Valeriana dageletiana f. integra, commonly known as the Japanese valerian, is a species of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and insomnia, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of depression. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana dageletiana f. integra are attributed to its sedative, anxiolytic, and antidepressant properties, which are mediated by its bioactive constituents, including valepotriates, valeranone, and isovaleric acid. These bioactive compounds are thought to interact with the GABA receptor, modulating the activity of the central nervous system and contributing to the plant's therapeutic effects.
